title: I duplicated id software's monster sprite pipeline
author: CoamIthra
selftext:
I'm making a Doom engine reimplementation (I would have said port but it's getting out of hand, heh). I wrote a bit about how to make sprites id-from-1993-style!

[https://haraldmaassen.com/devblog/post/vibecoding-doom-for-fun-and-profit](https://haraldmaassen.com/devblog/post/vibecoding-doom-for-fun-and-profit)

Also some bonus meandering on AI. There's a lot of hate towards it out there, especially when it comes to creative stuff like game making. I'm probably preaching to the choir in this community but here's the core of it:

>I picked up a project from 15 years ago that I had no reasonable way of finishing. I'm adding cool new monsters to my favorite game that look like they came right out of a secret 14th disc! I'm taking the midi tunes that have lived in my head for 30 years and remixing them with awesome guitar solos. I'm feeling creative even though I'm using AI! And I'm doing this with love, man. I'm not some cynical bro setting up a pipeline to spam 100 Kurzgesagt videos per day on Youtube. I'm taking a cultural icon that I love and adding to it.

So that's how I feel about AI. It's a very very complicated topic with loads of misinformation and extremism around it, but the actual thing that I'm running on my PC day-to-day is just so cool and useful and empowering, and I don't think we've even seen half of it yet.

Keep on making cool things!
